tasks.label: Build Game
tasks.detail: Builds QuestDash.sfc via the pvsneslib/devkitsnes Makefile.

tasks.label: Run Game
tasks.detail: Builds the ROM, verifies QuestDash.sfc exists, then launches it in Mesen2.
args: if (!(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}\QuestDash.sfc')) { Write-Error 'QuestDash.sfc was not found - the build must have failed.'; exit 1 }; Start-Process -FilePath "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\SourMesen.Mesen2_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\Mesen.exe" -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}\QuestDash.sfc'
